stemMd: Which claim best reflects the engineers' reasoning?

options.label: B
options.textMd: Legitimate consumption rules out simultaneous leaks.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Large users should be ignored when examining overnight flow.

options.label: D
options.textMd: One night always establishes the annual leakage rate.

options.label: E
options.textMd: An unusual aggregate reading can justify investigation without proving a single cause.

explanationMd: The engineers treat leakage as a hypothesis while evaluating alternative contributions to measured flow. The reading prompts investigation but does not uniquely identify its cause.

distractorRationale.d: Several nights are compared and no annual rate is established.
distractorRationale.a: The final sentence explicitly rejects that assumption.
distractorRationale.b: The residual can still indicate leakage.
